We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (from make_6_lvl2-template_search-2) to the molecule. We have the mapped_rxn and template_id from that input. The input says:

Input from 'make_6_lvl2-template_search-2' answer: a dict string:

{'mapped_rxn': 'C=C[C:6]1=[C:7](C=C)[CH:8]=[CH:9][CH:10]=[CH:11]1.C1=CC=CC=C1.[CH3:1][CH2:2][CH2:3][C:4](=[O:5])Cl.[Cl-].[Al+3].[Cl-].[Cl-]>>[CH3:1][CH2:2][CH2:3][C:4](=[O:5])[C:6]1=[CH:7][CH:8]=[CH:9][CH:10]=[CH:11]1'}

template_id: 80382

We need to apply this template to the target molecule (the product). The product SMILES is the right side of mapped_rxn: [CH3:1][CH2:2][CH2:3][C:4](=[O:5])[C:6]1=[CH:7][CH:8]=[CH:9][CH:10]=[CH:11]1

We need to get precursors via apply_template tool with that template_id and target SMILES.

Let's call apply_template.
